entries.title: A crewmate that waits on or reviews another keeps circling it, with an arrow
entries.body: On the main view, a crewmate waiting on another crewmate's work, or reviewing it, circles that crewmate. It used to jump back to its own place whenever a third crewmate passed close, and its arrow showed only while it was away. Now it keeps circling as other crewmates pass, and a quiet arrow always points at the crewmate it waits on or reviews.

picture.alt: The first mate with its crew in orbit, two crewmates each circling another with a short arrow pointing at the one it waits on or reviews
